name: Zola Mabena
bio:
Zola's passion for motorsport ignited early, fueled by watching Formula 1 races with her grandfather. She pursued a degree in mechanical engineering, specializing in vehicle dynamics, with the goal of contributing to a racing team. After graduating, she gained valuable experience as a data analyst for a smaller racing outfit, honing her skills in interpreting telemetry and identifying areas for improvement. 

Zola's meticulous approach to data analysis and her understanding of vehicle performance quickly made her an asset. She is determined to optimize every aspect of the test driver program, ensuring that simulations and track tests yield the most accurate and actionable insights. Her ability to communicate complex technical information in a clear and concise manner makes her an invaluable liaison between the drivers, engineers, and management. She is always looking for innovative solutions to improve testing efficiency and enhance driver feedback.

She joined Tickford Racing to coordinate their test driver program. She is known for her ability to get the most out of her testing budget and to ensure the team receives the most accurate feedback from the drivers.

physical.description: Zola has a focused gaze and athletic build from track days.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and observations.
Insists on brewing her own rooibos tea in the office.
Has a habit of tapping her pen rhythmically when concentrating.
